categories.name: Economy
categories.description: Research technology in the Economy Tree to increase Construction Speed, Resource Production, Vault Management, Army Capacity, Gem Gathering Speed, and Resource Gathering Speed. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Defense
categories.description: Research technology in the Defense tree to increase the strength of the Castle Wall , and to unlock and upgrade Traps . <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Military
categories.description: The Military Research increases army offense, defense, troop attack, army travel speed and scouting. Players can also research higher tiers of Troop in this tree. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Monster Hunt
categories.description: The Monster Hunt Research Tree increases Monster Hunting DMG and provides Energy boosts. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Upgrade Defenses
categories.description: The Upgrade Defenses research increases the strength of the player's Castle Wall and Traps , and unlocks the ability to repair damaged Traps. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Upgrade Military
categories.description: The Upgrade Military tree is where the player can research subsidies (to reduce Troop cost), Quick Swaps for Equipment , and Talent Sets, among various other boosts. Two Army Limit expansions can also be researched here. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Army Leadership
categories.description: The Army Leadership research tree allows the player to unlock various Army Lineup technologies, boosts to Gathering and Supply troops, an Army Limit expansion, and Enemy Army Debuffs, among various other boosts. Level 17 Academy is required. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Military Command
categories.description: The Military Command research tree is where the player can research a wide variety of economic and military boosts, especially Darknest -related boosts. Level 17 Academy is required. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Familiars
categories.description: For information on individual familiars, see: Familiar . The Familiars Research Tree unlocks Pacts 2 through 4, and other Turf and Familiar-related Boosts. All researches in this tree require Anima in addition to the usual resource. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Familiar Battles
categories.description: The Familiar Battles tree is where Familiar Battle Slots can be researched, allowing the player to send Awakened Familiars into battle. (Note: Awakening a Familiar requires a number of Bright Talent Orbs or Brilliant Talent Orbs) All researches in this tree require Anima in addition to the usual resource, and some also require Archaic Tomes. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Sigils
categories.description: For information on the sigil items, see: Sigil . The Sigils research tree is where the sigil slots (the 4th jewel slot) for Equipment can be unlocked, with research for boosts to Leader stats and Battle Fury in between. <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Wonder Battles
categories.description: Various Wonder rally technologies can be researched in the Wonder Battles tree to boost the player's capability when attacking and defending in War for Wonders . <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Gear
categories.description: Not to be confused with the player Equipment The Gear Research Tree is where players can research everything necessary to unlock Tier 5 (T5) Troops (see also the Barrack ), including the Lunar Foundry building. This tree requires a Level 25 Academy . <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Advanced Wonder Battles
categories.description: Various Wonder rally technologies and Leader stats can be researched in the Advanced Wonder Battles tree to boost the player's capability when attacking and defending in War for Wonders . <span class="mw-headline"

categories.name: Guild Duel
categories.description: This page is probably full of errors, I update and correct on the next event when I can collect and verify the information Contents 1 Game Text 1.1 Participation Requirements 1.2 Gameplay 1.3 Rewards 2 Notes 2.1 Day 1 - Familiar Growth 2.2 Day 2- Research Racer 2.3 Day 3 - Hero Coach 2.4 Day 4 - Artifact Resurgence 2.5 Day 5- Comprehensive Development 2.6 Rewards (Required points) Game Text [ ] When the duel begins, rivalry between guilds becomes inevitable. It is a true test of unity, determination, and resolve. Only those who endure to the very end will claim ultimate victory. Participation Requirements [ ] 1. Your guild must have more than 25 members before the event starts to participate. Players must be at Castle Lv15 or above during the event to participate. 2. You can only gain points for the guild you started the event in. Gameplay [ ] 1. After the event begins, guilds will be grouped with other guilds with similar Cup counts. Guilds in the same group will then face off in 1v1 duels. 2. The Guild Duel lasts for 5 days, with a different quest theme each day. Guild members can earn points by completing the daily themed quest during the event. All guild members' points are added together to form the day's Guild Points. 3. Points are rounded down. Any decimal places are dropped when calculating the points for each quest, before adding them to the points from other quests. 4. Finalization starts daily at 23:55 (GMT-5), and points can no longer be earned after this time. Once finalization is complete, the guild with the most Guild Points that day is declared the winner and receives that day's victory points). 5. When points are finalized on the 5th day, each guild's final score will be tallied based on their total points. The guild with the most points will claim the final victory in the Guild Duel. Rewards [ ] 1. Reward Categories Guild Participation Reward: All guild members who achieve both the daily guild point and solo point goals before daily finalization will receive a guild participation reward. Guild Victory/Consolation Reward: All guild members who reach the solo point goal will receive a reward, which varies depending on the duel's outcome. Solo Point Tier Rewards: Achieve the solo point tier goals before the daily finalization to claim these rewards. There are 9 reward tiers in total, and the tier you can claim depends on your research progress. Solo Point Ranking Rewards: Members from both guilds are ranked daily based on their solo points. Rewards are distributed according to your ranking, but you must reach the solo point goal to be eligible for ranking rewards. Notes [ ] Events appear to end at 04:55 GMT, this is important as some quests are long running and it would be best to start them a day or 2 before needed so the end shortly after the required for that quest starts, their might be a gap between the end of one quest and the start of the next.
